Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I4, which must be performed every three months 
as indicated by M3 in the title block.

type: THDI 93/43, 187.5 MVA,150 MW, 10.3kA, 10.5kV, 50Hz, 0.8 PF

Safety Precautions
Safety and healthy equipment must be used as
